First hand facts about what it was like to live under the Iron Curtain:

  1. Materials were scarce, so the government ordered bottles and things to be reused (not recycled) as much as possible. So sometimes when you got your beer ration from the grocery store with your friends one of them would actually get a bottle of cooking oil to drink.

  2. Bars closed at 8pm. People in his village had their minds blown when one of them came back from a visit from a western country and told them about the bars that stayed open much later. It became a dream/joke in that village that one day they'd be able to drink at 10pm or later.

  3. Anyone in a position of authority had to be bribed on a regular basis to keep them happy and out of your business.   5. No electricity at night, it was off for at least 4-6 hours during late night, even in winter.

The joke was if bombs started falling, put the children in the refrigerator because its stronger than the house.

Everyone basically had to become really great cooks and come up with their own spices because you weren't getting any variety elsewise.
